Source probes: none

evals.expected_output: A new design for data/storage at outputs/docs/packages/data/design/storage.md whose first line is `Mode: new`, carrying the eleven template headings with a Module plan and no Revision or As shipped heading, consuming Bar by citing the ingest README, a commit message `data/storage: design` with the run trailer in outputs/commit.txt, and a return of ten lines or fewer beginning `Result: done`.

The design contains, in this order, headings whose text includes: Purpose and scope; Inputs and outputs; Data model / internal contracts; Workflow / pipeline; Interfaces; Error handling and logging; Tests; Pitfalls and risks; Skills used; Contract deviations; Open questions
The design contains a `Module plan` under the Data model / internal contracts heading, listing files under packages/data/src/data/storage/ and naming which Interfaces rows each file defines

outputs/commit.txt exists and contains a first line `data/storage: design` and a trailer line `Dev-Team-Run: run-package data`
transcript.md records reading docs/packages/data/contract.md, docs/architecture.md and packages/data/src/data/ingest/README.md before writing the design
The final message in transcript.md is ten lines or fewer, its first line is exactly `Result: done`, and it contains lines beginning `Design:`, `Open questions:`, `Deviations:` and `Commit:`

No file exists under outputs/ other than docs/packages/data/design/storage.md, commit.txt and, if present, interview.md and the designer's own memory under .claude/agent-memory/designer/; in particular outputs/docs/decisions.md does not exist and the return is not `stopped`
evals.note_2_2: No line changed: the design path does not move and the run writes no ledger. The fixture repo/docs/deviations/data/storage.md, listed in `files` since ff5776a but never committed, is added in 2.2 phase 0 as a ledger at its 2.0-2.1 location (a title line and a note, no entries).

The transcript does not describe the contradiction as an Open questions entry, a Contract deviations entry or a Pitfalls and risks entry of a design; it is raised only as the ledger entry
evals.note_2_2: Changed: expected_output and expectations 2, 8, 9 and 10. The ledger path docs/deviations/data/prices.md becomes docs/packages/data/deviations/prices.md and the heading gains `— 1` (F13: `<k>` is the entry's sequence in its file, here a new file). Expectation 2 no longer asks that the fixture's title and note be kept: the fixture repo/docs/deviations/data/prices.md (listed in `files` since ff5776a but never committed; added in 2.2 phase 0) is the older location, read and never written, and the harness sheet says so; the expectation asks instead for the new file's title line and that the older file is not in outputs/. Expectation 9 reads the staged paths from the `---` block the harness sheet now asks for. Eval 5 took the additive half of the E1 test (a design is written, §10 lists the helper as a `deviation`), so this eval carries the boundary half: a consumer-visible contract fault is one `spec-change:contract` entry with `— <k>`, no design, and no `deviation` entry — already held by expectations 1, 2, 10 and 11.
